raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Use the optimized native gate/up GEMM for Gemma4's wide BF16 prefill at M=4096 when the installed binary confirms that specialization is available. Older binaries expose the generic tensor API with a slower large-M implementation, so API presence alone cannot select this route safely.

Stacked on [#44908](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44908), with native specialization/query dependency [sgl-kernel-xpu #558](https://github.com/sgl-project/sgl-kernel-xpu/pull/558). Parent is `ebc9d547`; tested child is `8b1ce6ce`.

## Modifications

- Resolve the binary-backed shape query during construction, outside compiled/captured forward. Select only BF16 B70, TP1, unquantized M4096/K1536/concatenated-N24576 wide MLPs under the parent's existing backend, hook, delegated-method, device and gradient guards.
- Reuse the parent's single 128 KiB table across all 35 MLPs. The 20 wide MLPs can use fused projection/lookup; the 15 narrow MLPs keep Torch projection plus lookup. Missing/false queries retain the parent route; M128 keeps its existing route.
- Add the public GEMM namespace entry and actual-wheel tests for native/fullgraph/capture execution, changed inputs/weights, aligned and offset views, shared ownership and legacy-wheel fallback.

Weights and the BF16 projection/activation rounding boundaries are preserved. The kernel implementation and M-fast scheduling live in native #558.

## Accuracy Tests

- Precommit passes; 72 namespace checks and 11 XPU model/public-activation tests pass against the actual isolated native wheel. Native compilation retains the actual operator across input/weight offsets 0/1/32; captured misalignment copies consume changed operands on poisoned replay. Constructor-time missing/false-query cases keep the standalone lookup.
- In the serving ABBA, all 480 timed prefill completions match output IDs/text across the four arms. All 16 compatibility prompts per arm return complete nonempty 16-token responses; IDs/text and every returned selected/top-five logprob field match across all four arms.
- Native #558 separately validates all 20 trained wide layers at M4096 across three activation scales against its previous implementation and the FP32/Torch references.

This draft inherits #44908's unresolved broader quality/determinism review. The serving checks above are bounded compatibility evidence, not a new model-quality evaluation; no additional 200-question evaluation was run for this child.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

One same-GPU ABBA on Intel B70, pinned Gemma4-E2B BF16 target/assistant, TP1/NEXTN (3 steps, 4 draft tokens), server `--random-seed 42`, direct-request `sampling_seed=42`, and benchmark `--seed 42`. Each arm uses four uncached warmups per workload and 24 interleaved samples per workload; each prompt has 4096 input tokens and one output token. Both candidate blocks beat both controls.

| Uncached request wall time | Control A1 | Candidate B1 | Candidate B2 | Control A2 | Reduction vs mean controls |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1×4096, ms | 191.462 | 187.689 | 187.221 | 191.749 | 2.17% |
| 4 queued×4096, ms | 753.209 | 738.054 | 738.103 | 753.104 | 2.00% |

Control drift is +0.15% / −0.014%. A separate CPU+XPU preflight proves 20 actual wide 128×128×32 native kernels, 20 matching CPU operation shapes, and 15 lookup kernels; startup records show 35 lookup slots, 20 wide-native slots, 15 narrow-none slots and one shared table. The preflight retires before timing; no forward hooks or timing observers are installed.

Canonical c8 warm/measured blocks each complete 64 requests×128 tokens with zero errors and explicit per-request cache fields. Reported TPOT is 0.54% lower within 1.06% control drift; the 56 common-text cases across all four arms show 0.31% lower saved streaming-ITL metric within 0.96% drift. **No decode speedup claim.**

Serving uses the exact #558 BMG kernel, registration and AST-extracted public API/query/Fake on the original featureful wheel, identically in both arms. All 87 original and two sidecar binary hashes/mappings and source immutability checks are retained. This is an exact-source sidecar result, not a full released-wheel serving result. The default path remains the parent fallback when the fast binary capability is unavailable.

Independent analysis reproduced every prefill/compatibility output, cache/length/error vectors, common-text/drift calculation and recorded binary provenance. All five servers retired; independent scans confirm no experiment owners, orphans or listener. Scope is this pinned workload/hardware and one paired ABBA.

## Checklist

- [x] Format code with precommit.
- [x] Add model/public API tests and preserve fallback coverage.
- [x] Document the capability/fallback contract in code and the native dependency.
- [x] Provide bounded numerical, compatibility, speed and profiler evidence.
- [ ] Resolve the broader inherited model-quality gate before merge/promotion.

+"""Actual optional fast-prefill wheel, model guards, and legacy-wheel fallback."""
+
+import unittest
+from types import MethodType
+
+import sgl_kernel
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
+
+from sglang.kernels.fused_op import get_fused_op_backend, set_fused_op_backend
+from sglang.kernels.spec import KernelBackend
+from sglang.srt.models.gemma3_causal import Gemma3MLP
+from sglang.srt.models.gemma4_causal import Gemma4MLP, Gemma4TextModel
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import SpawnRanks, create_context, use_context
+from sglang.srt.server_args import ServerArgs
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+_QUERY = "bf16_dense_gelu_tanh_mul_lut_xe20_prefill_supported"
+_HAS_FAST_PREFILL = (
+    torch.xpu.is_available()
+    and "B70" in torch.xpu.get_device_name()
+    and getattr(sgl_kernel, _QUERY, lambda *args: False)(4096, 24576, 1536)
+)
+
+
+def make_context():
+    snapshot = snapshot_download(
+        "google/gemma-4-E2B-it",
+        revision="3e22461f65e89153144f8adb70e3b8c2cc9845a7",
+        local_files_only=True,
+    )
+    return create_context(
+        ServerArgs(
+            model_path=snapshot,
+            device="xpu",
+            model_impl="sglang",
+            language_model_only=True,
+            attention_backend="intel_xpu",
+            page_size=64,
+            disable_overlap_schedule=True,
+        ),
+        role="test",
+        ranks=SpawnRanks(world_rank=0, gpu_id=0),
+    )
+
+
+def make_mlp(intermediate):
+    mlp = Gemma4MLP(1536, intermediate, "gelu_pytorch_tanh").to(
+        device="xpu", dtype=torch.bfloat16
+    )
+    mlp.gate_up_proj.weight.fill_(1 / 256)
+    mlp.down_proj.weight.fill_(1 / 256)
+    return mlp
+
+
+def make_owner(*modules):
+    owner = Gemma4TextModel.__new__(Gemma4TextModel)
+    torch.nn.Module.__init__(owner)
+    for index, module in enumerate(modules):
+        owner.add_module(str(index), module)
+    owner._initialize_xpu_gate_up_lut()
+    owner._assert_xpu_gate_up_lut_initialized()
+    return owner
+
+
+def reference(mlp, x):
+    # Aligned clones avoid Torch's known BF16 offset-one GEMM issue. These
+    # binary-fraction operands also have exactly representable FP32 dot products.
+    projected = F.linear(x.clone(), mlp.gate_up_proj.weight.clone())
+    return F.linear(sgl_kernel.gelu_tanh_and_mul(projected), mlp.down_proj.weight)
+
+
+def native_count(graph):
+    return sum(
+        node.op == "call_function"
+        and node.target
+        in (
+            torch.ops.sgl_kernel.bf16_dense_gelu_tanh_mul_lut_xe20,
+            torch.ops.sgl_kernel.bf16_dense_gelu_tanh_mul_lut_xe20.default,
+        )
+        for node in graph.graph.nodes
+    )
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(_HAS_FAST_PREFILL, "requires the fast-prefill native wheel on B70")
+class TestGemma4PrefillGemm(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_shared_owner_native_compile_replay_and_fallback_guards(self):
+        context = make_context()
+        previous = get_fused_op_backend()
+        set_fused_op_backend(None)
+        try:
+            with (
+                use_context(context),
+                context.parallel.override(tp_group=None, attn_tp_group=None),
+                torch.no_grad(),
+            ):
+                wide, narrow = make_mlp(12288), make_mlp(6144)
+                self.assertIsNotNone(wide._xpu_prefill_gate_up_lut)
+                self.assertIsNone(narrow._xpu_prefill_gate_up_lut)
+                owner = make_owner(wide, narrow)
+                for mlp in (wide, narrow):
+                    self.assertIs(
+                        mlp._xpu_gate_up_gelu_table, owner._xpu_gate_up_lut_owner
+                    )
+                graphs = []
+
+                def backend(graph, _):
+                    graphs.append(graph)
+                    return graph.forward
+
+                compiled = torch.compile(wide, backend=backend, fullgraph=True)
+                original_weight = wide.gate_up_proj.weight.detach().clone()
+                for offset, scale in ((32, 1), (1, 0.5), (0, -1)):
+                    x = torch.full(
+                        (4096 * 1536 + offset,),
+                        1 / 32 * scale,
+                        device="xpu",
+                        dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+                    )[offset:].view(4096, 1536)
+                    weight = torch.empty(
+                        original_weight.numel() + offset,
+                        device="xpu",
+                        dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+                    )[offset:].view_as(original_weight)
+                    weight.copy_(original_weight * scale)
+                    wide.gate_up_proj.weight.data = weight
+                    torch.testing.assert_close(
+                        compiled(x), reference(wide, x), atol=0, rtol=0
+                    )
+                self.assertTrue(graphs)
+                self.assertTrue(all(native_count(graph) == 1 for graph in graphs))
+                self.assertTrue(
+                    all(
+                        "triton_kernel_wrapper" not in str(graph.graph)
+                        for graph in graphs
+                    )
+                )
+
+                # Both operands are offset-one views so host alignment clones
+                # must themselves be captured and read changed data on replay.
+                x = torch.full(
+                    (4096 * 1536 + 1,), 1 / 32, device="xpu", dtype=torch.bfloat16
+                )[1:].view(4096, 1536)
+                weight = torch.empty(
+                    original_weight.numel() + 1, device="xpu", dtype=torch.bfloat16
+                )[1:].view_as(original_weight)
+                weight.copy_(original_weight)
+                wide.gate_up_proj.weight.data = weight
+                wide(x)
+                torch.xpu.synchronize()
+                graph = torch.xpu.XPUGraph()
+                with torch.xpu.graph(graph):
+                    output = wide(x)
+                for scale_x, scale_w in ((0.5, 2), (-1, 0.25)):
+                    x.mul_(scale_x)
+                    weight.mul_(scale_w)
+                    output.fill_(float("nan"))
+                    graph.replay()
+                    torch.xpu.synchronize()
+                    torch.testing.assert_close(
+                        output, reference(wide, x), atol=0, rtol=0
+                    )
+
+                wide.gate_up_proj.weight.data = weight.clone()
+                x = x.clone()
+
+                def forbidden(*args):
+                    raise AssertionError(
+                        "guarded fallback reached an optimized callback"
+                    )
+
+                wide._xpu_prefill_gate_up_lut = forbidden
+                wide._xpu_gelu_mul_lut = forbidden
+                # M128 remains the ordinary parent model route.
+                small = x[:128].contiguous()
+                torch.testing.assert_close(
+                    wide(small), Gemma3MLP.forward(wide, small), atol=0, rtol=0
+                )
+                for method in ("forward_xpu", "_forward_impl"):
+                    original = getattr(wide.act_fn, method)
+                    calls = []
+
+                    def replacement(module, value):
+                        calls.append(method)
+                        return torch.zeros_like(value[..., :12288])
+
+                    setattr(wide.act_fn, method, MethodType(replacement, wide.act_fn))
+                    wide.act_fn._forward_method = None
+                    try:
+                        self.assertEqual(torch.count_nonzero(wide(x)).item(), 0)
+                        self.assertEqual(calls, [method])
+                    finally:
+                        setattr(wide.act_fn, method, original)
+                        wide.act_fn._forward_method = None
+                observed = []
+                handle = wide.act_fn.register_forward_hook(
+                    lambda *args: observed.append(True)
+                )
+                try:
+                    torch.testing.assert_close(
+                        wide(x), reference(wide, x), atol=0, rtol=0
+                    )
+                    self.assertEqual(len(observed), 1)
+                finally:
+                    handle.remove()
+                set_fused_op_backend(KernelBackend.TORCH)
+                torch.testing.assert_close(
+                    wide(x), Gemma3MLP.forward(wide, x), atol=0, rtol=0
+                )
+        finally:
+            set_fused_op_backend(previous)
+            torch._dynamo.reset()
+
+    def test_legacy_api_with_missing_or_false_query_keeps_lookup(self):
+        context = make_context()
+        previous = get_fused_op_backend()
+        set_fused_op_backend(None)
+        try:
+            with (
+                use_context(context),
+                context.parallel.override(tp_group=None, attn_tp_group=None),
+                torch.no_grad(),
